text_block_list.text:
After the race, Maruzensky looked back and 
smiled, glad to have had another fun run 
today.

However... as she walked toward the press 
conference, her back carried a tinge of 
melancholy.

That night, the Trainer ran into Special 
Week, whose heart was racing with 
excitement after watching Maruzensky's 
race.

In the Trainer's eyes, she appeared in 
stark contrast to the Maruzensky of today.
